To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the existing matchmaking systems depend on the assumption of fairness and that this assumption sometimes fails.

(1) the current matchmaking systems are designed to maximize the fairness of the games, but (2) the fairness is not the only factor that determines the engagement, and (3) we propose a new matchmaking system that optimizes the engagement, which can be used to maximize the player retention and monetization.

(i) a fair game is not always best for player engagement; (ii) a new framework for engagement optimized matchmaking is needed; and (iii) EOMM outperforms existing matchmaking methods in enhancing player engagement.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of matchmaking in online games and proposes a framework that can be used to optimize engagement of players in games.
how to design a better matchmaking framework to improve overall player experience, and we have demonstrated that our EOMM framework is a promising solution.
a fundamental question: what makes a game engaging? Our answer: a fair game is not the only way to create engagement.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have developed a framework for matchmaking that is based on engagement rather than on fairness.
the proposed EOMM framework can be applied to a variety of online games and that it is a more effective matchmaking method than current methods.
our framework is a new paradigm for matchmaking and can be used to optimize player experience.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the optimal player experience is not necessarily the most fair game.
we have developed a novel matchmaking framework that maximizes player engagement, which is an alternative and more important objective than fairness.
the current matchmaking systems are not optimized for player engagement.

a single core strategy for matchmaking is insufficient.
the optimal strategy for matchmaking depends on the specific goals of the system.
a fair game does not guarantee the best player experience.
